first_useful_action.note: Confirmed sealed identity-only DTOs and CE-5 structural no-leak tests.

answer: To add a new identity-only GCTX MCP tool without leaking source text, touch the CE-5 spine end-to-end: (1) crates/anvil-gctx-types — sealed egress DTOs plus the CE-5 structural no-leak serialised-shape tests (hard gate; crate depends only on anvil_kernel_types + serde, never anvil-graph-cache); (2) crates/anvil-gctx-egress — extend GctxProjector, the single CE-5 choke point that builds identity-only DTOs from the warm graph; (3) crates/anvil-graph-cache only if the tool needs new substrate reads (hot index / walks), keeping producer internals off the wire; (4) crates/anvil-cli MCP dispatch — new tool module under mcp/tools/ plus registry registration (charges_graph_egress, identity-only descriptor); (5) docs/architecture/graph-context-delivery-spec.md CE-5 / CE-1 contract and any proto/RPC if a new anvil/gctx/* method is required. Default remains identity-only (no source text); SnippetResult is the lone CE-1 carve-out behind egress consent. Keep anvil_validate_write on edits. This V1 session used no GCTX tools and no Decision Brief as a gate.
